mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, serial_number, contract_project_id, artifact_quantity, total_area, create_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT mcp.*, mcpd.id AS detail_id, mcpd.create_time AS detail_create_time, mcpd.update_time AS detail_update_time, mcpd.bool_delete_enum AS detail_bool_delete_enum, mcpd.version AS detail_version, mcpd.coating_process_id AS detail_coating_process_id, mcpd.paint_type AS detail_paint_type, mcpd.paint_brand AS detail_paint_brand, mcpd.paint_category AS detail_paint_category, mcpd.thickness AS detail_thickness, mcpd.remark AS detail_remark, mcpd.use_quantity AS detail_use_quantity, su.name AS create_user_name, cp.short_name AS contract_project_short_name, cp.serial_number AS contract_project_serial_number FROM mes_coating_process mcp LEFT JOIN mes_coating_process_detail mcpd ON mcpd.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mcpd.coating_process_id = mcp.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = mcp.create_user_id LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.id = mcp.contract_project_id WHERE mcp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mcp.contract_project_id = #{contractProjectId}

SELECT mcp.*, mcpd.id AS detail_id, mcpd.create_time AS detail_create_time, mcpd.update_time AS detail_update_time, mcpd.bool_delete_enum AS detail_bool_delete_enum, mcpd.version AS detail_version, mcpd.coating_process_id AS detail_coating_process_id, mcpd.paint_type AS detail_paint_type, mcpd.paint_brand AS detail_paint_brand, mcpd.paint_category AS detail_paint_category, mcpd.thickness AS detail_thickness, mcpd.remark AS detail_remark, mcpd.use_quantity AS detail_use_quantity, cp.serial_number as contract_project_serial_number, cp.short_name as contract_project_short_name FROM mes_coating_process mcp LEFT JOIN mes_coating_process_detail mcpd ON mcpd.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mcpd.coating_process_id = mcp.id LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.id = mcp.contract_project_id WHERE mcp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mcp.id = #{id}
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(serial_number, '-', -1) AS SIGNED)), 0) AS max_serial_number FROM mes_coating_process WHERE bool_delete_enum = FALSE
